items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: And it was right at the very most ultimate scene you know, Dorothy’s going to come back to — where’s she from?

ctx.x: Man, you just gave me a memory because I had a similar thing with the bass clarinet, you know like a summer concert band and I agreed to play bass clarinet and at the rehearsal I couldn’t play the part and the guy said, “All right, we just won’t play this song.”

Oh it’s so bad. Yeah, and you just feel everyone around you, you just feel their energy. I’ll tell you another funny story, I was playing, I was doing a theater show in Sydney years ago, like I’d kind of sub in on some of these theater gigs. And it was “The Wizard of Oz” you know, which is an amazing score, like it was beautifully written. And it was right at the very most ultimate scene you know, Dorothy’s going to come back to — where’s she from? © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
